name: risk-aware-trading-agents
summary: Risk-aware AI trading agents for US stocks, with news backtesting that cannot see the future: FOMC/CPI/VIX-aware market regimes, EMA 50/100/200 dip buying with earnings checks, cross-verified news (Finviz + RSS + SEC), a 30% cash floor, a point-in-time 2026 research dataset with a look-ahead check, LLM agents over MCP, and paper/live trading on Alpaca, Interactive Brokers, Public, Schwab, Tradier, tastytrade, Futu/moomoo, Tiger and Longbridge.
author: Risk-Aware Trading Agents contributors
